issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' produces corrupt bytes when PIL decodes the image as RGBA, P, or L
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNG/JPEG that PIL may open in non-RGB modes. Calling tobytes() without first calling image.convert('RGB') yields a buffer whose byte count and channel order don't match the declared format='RGB', so downstream consumers read garbage. Fix: image = image.convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Module-import-time monkey-patch of private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is a process-global side effect
issues.detail: Reaching into a third-party SDK's private underscore attribute and mutating it at import time affects every google-genai consumer in the process and will break when the attribute is renamed. The 'temporary hack' comment confirms it. Configure via the public HttpOptions/client API at construction time or file an upstream fix.

issues.description: Image-model detection by substring 'image' in model name is fragile
issues.detail: The predicate `'image' in self._model_name` couples a behavioral invariant (skip thinking budget) to Google's naming convention. Future models like gemini-3-vision-image or imagen variants will silently misroute. Replace with an explicit capability table or named predicate keyed by model id.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior shift bundled into a feature PR
issues.detail: Existing callers relying on the default get different latency, cost, and thinking-budget behavior on upgrade. The CHANGELOG notes it, but the change should be a separate PR with a deprecation path so consumers can reason about and revert it independently of the image-generation feature.

issues.description: No error handling or size bound on inline image data; malformed or oversized payloads crash _process_context
issues.detail: part.inline_data.data is fed unconditionally to BytesIO and PIL.Image.open with no try/except, no MIME check, and no size cap. A malformed payload raises UnidentifiedImageError and aborts the entire streaming loop; an oversized one risks OOM. Wrap the decode, log failures, and continue processing remaining parts.

issues.description: New image-emission branch ships without tests covering the part-to-frame conversion
issues.detail: The new elif has no unit test feeding a synthetic inline_data part and asserting the resulting OutputImageRawFrame has correct size, mode, and bytes. A small test would have caught the RGB/RGBA mismatch immediately and would document the contract for downstream consumers of GoogleLLMService image frames.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on two P0 defects: image.tobytes() is called without converting from PIL's actual mode to RGB, producing corrupt buffers for the RGBA/P/L images Gemini commonly returns; and a self-described 'temporary hack' monkey-patches a private google-genai attribute at module import, leaking a process-global side effect into every consumer. Three P1 concerns follow: substring-based image-model detection is fragile, the default-model bump to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent behavior shift smuggled into a feature PR, and the new image path has no error handling or size bound. Recommend: convert to RGB explicitly, replace the monkey-patch with public-API configuration, use a capability table for model detection, split the default-model change into its own PR, add try/except around image decoding, and add a unit test for the new branch.
